videoData.title: Momo - Skill & Gear Priorities | Sword of Convallaria

textData.text: In this episode, I cover Momo, a fan-favorite character from Sword of Convallaria, and provide detailed answers to viewer questions about her rank skills and upcoming banners. I dive into specific abilities like Energy Ray and Erosive Power, discuss gear choices including the Diffusing Prism and Resentment Broom, and explore optimal strategies for PvP and PvM. I also review useful websites and resources for more detailed information. Join me as we explore how to maximize Momo's potential in various game modes.
